name: eslint-plugin-codebase-ai-rules
description: Focused ESLint rules for AI-assisted codebases: comment discipline for JS/TS, broken relative links in Markdown, and design-token checks for CSS and JS/TS.

scripts.check: npm test && node --check src/index.mjs && node --check src/markdown.mjs && node --check src/design.mjs && node --check src/comment-discipline.mjs && node --check src/comment-directives.mjs && node --check src/comment-ranges.mjs && node --check src/no-broken-relative-links.mjs && node --check src/relative-links.mjs && node --check src/repository-paths.mjs && node --check src/colors.mjs && node --check src/css-values.mjs && node --check src/design-tokens.mjs && node --check src/file-globs.mjs && node --check src/design-no-raw-color.mjs && node --check src/design-no-raw-color-literal.mjs && node --check src/design-no-unknown-token.mjs && node --check src/design-scale-value.mjs
